source.name: ahkab test-suite circuits (SPICE3/ngspice translation)
source.redistributionDecision: Allowed under GPL-2.0-only. Translated decks are modified versions of the upstream test circuits: each carries a header naming the upstream file, the modification date and every change, and the upstream notice and complete GPLv2 text are distributed alongside. ahkab reference result files are copied byte-for-byte.
source.mechanicalAdaptation: Deterministic syntactic translation by benchmarks/translate/ahkab-to-spice3.ts from the byte-identical corpus-d originals (which stay unchanged in benchmarks/corpus/corpus-d). Per translated deck: line 1 (the title) is kept verbatim and a comment header records the upstream file, licence, modification date and every change. Mappings: type=vdc/idc vdc=/idc= -> DC; vac=/iac= -> AC; keyed ahkab PULSE/SIN -> positional SPICE3 PULSE/SIN (same formulas); ahkab AM(sa oc fm fc td) -> ngspice AM(0 sa*oc sa fm fc td) (same waveform); `.model diode <name>` -> `.model <name> D` (ahkab diode defaults equal SPICE3 defaults); `.tran` uic=0 or uic=2 -> UIC only where both provably start from the zero state; method=trap -> .options method=trap; method=gearN -> .options method=gear maxord=N (variable- instead of fixed-order Gear, stated per deck); decks with diodes get `.temp 26.85` and `.options tnom=26.85` because ahkab evaluates devices at 300 K; inline `*` comments move to their own line; `.end` is added where missing. Anything else (EKV MOSFETs, the tanh-smoothed ahkab switch, .symbolic, .fft, .pss, ahkab .pz, AC log grids with non-integer points per decade, named .ic sets, named-port subcircuits) is not approximated: the fixture is marked unsupported-translation with the reasons.

ahkab `type=vdc vdc=X` written as SPICE3 `DC X`

ahkab `.model diode <name>` (type before name) written as SPICE3 `.model <name> D`; the ahkab diode defaults IS=1e-14, N=1, RS=0, CJ0=0, TT=0, BV=inf, IBV=1e-3, EG=1.11, XTI=3 equal the SPICE3 defaults (ahkab VJ=0.7 vs SPICE3 1 V only enters through CJ0=0)
added `.temp 26.85` and `.options tnom=26.85`: ahkab simulates and specifies diode parameters at 300 K, SPICE3 defaults to 27 C (300.15 K)
added the `.end` card SPICE3 requires
